headline.en: Revenue growth did not translate into higher reported operating income.
headline.zh: 收入增长未转化为更高的报告营业利润。

interpretation.en: The reported cost increase exceeded the revenue increase. This is an accounting explanation, not a measure of advertising-only profitability.
interpretation.zh: 报告成本的增量超过收入增量。这是会计变动解释，不代表广告业务单独的盈利能力。

limitation.en: Charges and consolidated investments are included. The evidence does not isolate AI returns or establish permanent margin deterioration.
limitation.zh: 数据包含相关费用和合并投资；尚不能单独衡量AI回报，也不能据此认定利润率将持续恶化。

next_observation.en: Watch whether subsequent monetization gains produce higher retained profit and cash after the required investment.
next_observation.zh: 观察后续变现增长能否在必要投入后带来更高的留存利润和现金。

headline.en: Search and Network moved in different directions.
headline.zh: 搜索与联盟网络收入呈现不同走势。

interpretation.en: Separate owned-property growth from Network. Consolidated cash is issuer context, not a Search profit calculation.
interpretation.zh: 应区分自有平台与联盟网络的收入变化；合并现金流是公司层面的背景，不是搜索业务的利润计算。

limitation.en: A negative quarterly cash figure can coexist with positive trailing-year cash. No matched numerical revenue guide is established in this source set.
limitation.zh: 单季现金流为负可与过去十二个月现金流为正并存；本资料集未确立可比的量化收入指引。

next_observation.en: Watch category-level monetization, distribution expense and investment conversion without assigning all company spending to Search.
next_observation.zh: 观察各业务变现、分发成本与投资转化，勿将全公司支出全部归于搜索业务。

expectation.question: original company outlook delivery
expectation.printed_value_reading: no matched numerical guide in selected sources

headline.en: Revenue rose while reported operating income fell.
headline.zh: 收入上升，但报告营业利润下降。

interpretation.en: The operating-cost bridge explains the divergence. A retention headline alone cannot establish spending growth within existing customers.
interpretation.zh: 营业成本变动可解释收入与利润的分化；仅凭客户留存标题不能证明现有客户支出增长。

limitation.en: Reported presentation is not a normalized or organic-growth analysis. Original-guide delivery is not a consensus-surprise claim.
limitation.zh: 报告口径不等同于标准化或有机增长分析；对最初指引的兑现比较不代表相对市场共识的超预期。

next_observation.en: Watch existing-client spending and retained contribution, with any accounting changes explicitly bridged.
next_observation.zh: 观察现有客户支出和留存贡献，并明确解释会计口径变化。

headline.en: Contribution ex-TAC and reported gross profit increased.
headline.zh: 扣除流量获取成本后的贡献额与报告毛利润均有增长。

interpretation.en: Cost-side and channel breakdowns explain the same contribution change. Use them as alternative views, not additive gains.
interpretation.zh: 成本端与渠道拆分解释的是同一贡献额变化；它们是不同视角，不能相加为多份收益。

limitation.en: Contribution ex-TAC is not GAAP revenue, and derived TAC is not independent confirmation. Different peer growth does not prove budget transfer.
limitation.zh: 扣除TAC后的贡献额不是GAAP收入，推导出的TAC也不是独立验证；同行增速不同不能证明预算转移。

next_observation.en: Watch whether connected-TV contribution persists and converts to profit and cash under unchanged definitions.
next_observation.zh: 观察联网电视贡献能否持续，并在一致口径下转化为利润和现金。

scenarios.name: Useful original comparison; no final history
scenarios.review_note: Unknown optional consensus does not erase a qualified original-guide view.

scenarios.name: Missing prior observation
scenarios.review_note: Use a level-only headline, not yesterday's growth sentence.

scenarios.name: Current source is unavailable
scenarios.review_note: Historical cash is not displayed as a substitute current headline; current card is not ready.

scenarios.name: Missing original outlook
scenarios.review_note: No matched statement in reviewed sources is not never-guided or final-history proof.

scenarios.name: Source correction invalidates only dependent interpretation
scenarios.review_note: This scenario assumes the newly retained level is validated; no stale interpretation beside it.

scenarios.name: Incompatible period/population rule
scenarios.review_note: Level is retained; period-change badge is absent until comparability is qualified.

scenarios.name: Source rights revoked
scenarios.review_note: No stale restricted sentence may remain; only separately public roster/navigation survives.

scenarios.name: Cash recipe incomplete
scenarios.review_note: Do not fill the residual with a fictional expense; use the previous complete bridge only as explicit history.

scenarios.name: Unresolved identity
scenarios.review_note: A named business remains researchable without a fabricated ticker.

scenarios.name: Company page works; save not performed
scenarios.review_note: Navigation does not prove a saved watchlist item.

scenarios.name: Explicit watchlist save has its own receipt
scenarios.review_note: Synthetic receipt token only; no real user account was modified.

scenarios.name: A Q3 guide cannot replace a missing Q2 original
scenarios.review_note: An unrelated token cannot satisfy original_guide. Not a language-extraction test.

scenarios.name: Quoted analyst premise is not a company guide
scenarios.review_note: Review annotations determine provenance; the replay does not read a transcript.

scenarios.name: A later expected expense does not rewrite the old revenue comparison
scenarios.review_note: Separate period/measure section; no old-period expense deduction or revenue overwrite.

scenarios.name: Peer has stronger reported growth
scenarios.review_note: No budget-transfer or share-loss conclusion is available from this token.

scenarios.name: Account entitlement denied
scenarios.review_note: At runtime denial must occur before reads. This replay tests only an authored expected emission table.

scenarios.name: Potentially mixed-generation inputs
scenarios.review_note: Keep a level only if its own owner validates it. No ready-generation claim for a mixed package.

scenarios.name: Complete final-history evidence becomes available
scenarios.review_note: Synthetic admission condition, not the present research state; no new archive is created.

scenarios.name: Complete consensus evidence becomes available
scenarios.review_note: Hypothetical owner evidence. It still supplies no automatic trading authority.

scenarios.name: Original and final guides are different questions
scenarios.review_note: A candidate final statement without complete coverage/rule is insufficient.

level_only.en: Reported level available; a comparable prior period is not qualified.
level_only.zh: 报告数值可用；尚未确认可比的上一期数据。

guidance_missing.en: No matched numerical outlook in the reviewed sources.
guidance_missing.zh: 已审阅资料中未找到匹配的量化指引。

history_incomplete.en: Compared with the original outlook; final pre-result history is not established.
history_incomplete.zh: 与最初指引比较；尚未确立业绩公布前最后一次指引的完整记录。

interpretation_stale.en: The source changed. The previous interpretation is withheld pending review.
interpretation_stale.zh: 资料已变化；原有解读暂停显示，等待重新审阅。

rounded_boundary.en: Published values match; the underlying threshold comparison is indeterminate.
rounded_boundary.zh: 公布数值相同；底层数值是否跨越阈值尚无法确定。

route_unqualified.en: Business research is available; the stock link is not yet verified.
route_unqualified.zh: 业务研究可用；股票链接尚未验证。

private_unavailable.en: Research is temporarily unavailable. The existing Themes view is unchanged.
private_unavailable.zh: 研究内容暂不可用；原有主题页面保持不变。

cash_incomplete.en: Cash components do not yet support a complete reconciliation.
cash_incomplete.zh: 现金项目尚不足以支持完整勾稽。

interpretation_limits: Annotations are authored, not validated natural-language extraction.
No experimental token is a native source, identity, rights or storage receipt.
No live owner, HTTP handler, renderer or watchlist is executed.
Financial numbers are printed-value research, not certified underlying precision.
Negative reported business results may be well-supported; favorable direction is not evidence readiness.
All four public example company labels stay in the coverage denominator; unavailable private evidence must not leak via counts.
